title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on Numbers 16: the rebellion of Korah, Dathan and Abiram, the ground that swallowed them, and Aaron standing between the dead and the living.

questions.text: Who was the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, who took some men and rose up before Moses?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens with Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, taking men together with Dathan, Abiram and On.

questions.text: How many princes of the congregation rose up with them before Moses?
questions.explanation: They rose up before Moses with two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, men of renown.

questions.text: What did Moses tell Korah and his company to take, put fire in and put incense on before Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Moses told Korah and all his company to take censers, put fire in them and put incense on them before Yahweh the next day.

questions.text: What did Dathan and Abiram answer when Moses sent to call them?
questions.explanation: Dathan and Abiram refused and said, "We won't come up!"

questions.text: How did Dathan and Abiram describe the land Moses had brought them up out of?
questions.explanation: They complained that Moses had brought them up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill them in the wilderness.

answers.text: A land flowing with milk and honey
A house of bondage and hard labor
A land of brick, straw and sorrow
A land of famine and great drought

questions.text: As Moses finished speaking all these words, what did the earth do to them and their households?
questions.explanation: The ground under them split apart, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households.

answers.text: It shook and threw down their tents
It burned with fire beneath them
It opened its mouth and swallowed them up

questions.text: What devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense?
questions.explanation: Fire came out from Yahweh and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

questions.text: What were the bronze censers of those who were burned made into?
questions.explanation: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers, and they were beaten out for a covering of the altar, as a memorial to the children of Israel.

answers.text: Plates for a covering of the altar

questions.text: What did the whole congregation say to Moses and Aaron on the next day?
questions.explanation: On the next day the congregation complained against Moses and Aaron, saying, "You have killed Yahweh's people!"

answers.text: "Let us choose a captain and return to Egypt!"

questions.text: How many died by the plague, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah?
questions.explanation: Aaron stood between the dead and the living with incense and the plague was stayed; fourteen thousand seven hundred had died by it.
